en-US.读取超时，已保留之前的数据。: Reading timed out. Previous data was kept.

en-US.如何刷新银行数据？: How do I refresh bank data?
en-US.点击银行旁的刷新按钮，打开银行官网。: Click Refresh bank to open the bank website.
en-US.自行登录或完成手机确认；密码只交给银行。: Sign in or approve on your phone. Only share your password with your bank.
en-US.打开账户或卡片详情，在引导条读取本页。: Open account or card details, then read the page from the guide.
en-US.这只载入已有记录，不会访问银行。: This loads existing records without visiting banks.
en-US.未连接到本机解析服务，请确认本机调试服务已启动。: Cannot reach the local parser. Make sure the development service is running.
en-US.需要登录时在银行官网完成；未读取到的字段保留原值与原日期。: Sign in on the bank website when needed. Unread fields keep their values and dates.
en-US.不再需要分别启动金额读取与 AI 任务。同一轮进度会说明已更新、未找到、需要登录: One refresh handles amounts and AI parsing. Progress distinguishes updates, missing data, sign-in and offline services. Missing data never means a zero balance.
en-US.回到钱包查看本轮结果，未读取的项目保留原记录。: Return to the wallet for results. Unread items keep their previous records.
en-US.本机调试服务可在设置中连接，无需在扩展填写密钥。: Connect the local development service in Settings. No API key entry is needed in the extension.
en-US.已在一个开发账户上实测部分金额: Some amounts verified live on one development account
en-US.真实验证目前只来自一个开发账户。其他卡片只经过合成页面测试，可能漏读，也可能把其: Real verification comes from one development account so far. Other cards are tested on synthetic pages only, so a card may be missed or another account listed as a card.
en-US.已接入统一刷新，实际结果待核对: Included in unified refresh; live results need verification
en-US.银行页面会变化。完成一轮刷新不代表每类数据都已读取，具体以银行卡片上的本次结果与: Bank pages change. A completed refresh may leave some categories unread. Check the bank results and field dates.
en-US.清除读数只影响扩展采集的数据，导入的历史备份仍会保留。: Clearing readings affects extension-collected data only. Imported historical backups remain.
en-US.银行页面加载超时: Bank page took too long to load
en-US.仅部分卡片已读取积分: Points read for some cards only
en-US.已读取所有登记卡片的积分；共用积分池关系单独核对: Points read for all registered cards; shared accounts are checked separately
en-US.MVP 刷新只读取积分、余额、账单、最低还款与还款日。优惠、福利和交易不参与本轮: MVP refresh reads points, balances, statements, minimum payments and payment due dates only. Offers, benefits and transactions are excluded.
en-US.此前的代码与历史记录均保留；MVP 默认不刷新这些数据。: Previous code and historical records are retained; MVP refresh does not update these sections.
en-US.已读取必需的积分；其他积分计划此版本不采集: Required rewards read; other programmes are not collected in this version
en-US.页面上未看到积分: No rewards seen on the page
en-US.本轮只读取余额、账单、还款日和积分；缺少的项目保留原数据与原日期。: This run reads balances, billing, due dates and rewards only. Missing fields retain their previous values and dates.
en-US.本轮读取提前结束: This refresh stopped before all pages were read
en-US.自动用 AI 推测未识别的卡种: Ask AI about unrecognised card types automatically
en-US.默认关闭。开启后，钱包会把未识别卡片的银行、地区和卡名（不含尾号和金额）发给你配: Off by default. When on, the wallet sends the bank, region and card name of unrecognised cards (no last digits or amounts) to the model you set up, once per name. You confirm each suggestion in card details.
en-US.AI 解析未启用：请在设置里添加模型密钥: AI parsing is off: add a model key in Settings
en-US.允许刷新时，将脱敏后的金额、积分和账单片段直接发送给 DeepSeek 解析。: During a refresh, send redacted amounts, points and statement excerpts straight to DeepSeek to parse.
en-US.暂时读不到 AI 设置，请稍后重试。: Couldn’t read the AI settings. Try again shortly.
en-US.本页由本机调试服务提供，AI 使用服务端 .env.local 里的配置。: This page is served by the local development service, and AI uses its .env.local settings.
en-US.模型密钥无效或已过期，请在设置里更换: The model key is invalid or expired; replace it in Settings
